design_rule: Characterize one deterministic fault at a time. Run selected A, B, and A+B factorials only after both single-fault signatures are stable.

experiments.title: Stale retrieval and artifact-version skew
experiments.hypothesis: One repository-version mismatch can simultaneously corrupt retrieved evidence, worker input state, verifier validity, and reviewer provenance.
experiments.injected_fault: Serve retrieval results and one cached verifier result from revision N after the workspace advances to N+1.
experiments.control_condition: All retrieval, execution, verification, and review artifacts are bound to revision N+1.
experiments.treatment_condition: Only retrieval and cached verification inputs remain bound to N; the working tree and task target are N+1.
experiments.exact_injection_point: Atomically advance the workspace after index publication and baseline verification, before the next query and acceptance check.

gate_measurements.measurement: Paired outcome and per-gate failure vector by version-skew condition.
gate_measurements.grading: Rejection rate for stale verifier results and correctness of the terminal verdict.
gate_measurements.containment_and_recovery: Workspace, input-state, and artifact-version identity agreement at each transition.
gate_measurements.retrieval_and_context: Current-evidence rate and stale-call generation rate.
gate_measurements.review_and_accountability: Reviewer detection of version skew and provenance-version completeness.
gate_measurements.allocation_and_cost: Retries, re-index calls, verifier calls, latency, and token/cost delta.

experiments.end_to_end_task_outcome: Patch matches N+1 interfaces and passes version-bound verification.
experiments.retry_count: Count re-index, regeneration, and re-verification attempts.
experiments.latency: Time from workspace advance to accepted or failed terminal state.
experiments.token_cost: Tokens and cost for stale work discarded plus corrective work.
experiments.expected_causal_signature: The version-skew event precedes failures in multiple gates; a freshness/version gate blocks all of them without changing model output quality under the control.
experiments.stopping_criteria: Stop on an unauthorized publication; otherwise complete all paired revision fixtures and require exact version identities in every retained trace.

experiments.title: Structurally valid silent tool corruption
experiments.hypothesis: A semantically wrong but structurally valid tool result can damage retrieval, planning state, failure classification, and task outcome together.
experiments.injected_fault: Replace one successful search or inspection result with a schema-valid wrong result and no error flag.
experiments.control_condition: Return the recorded correct tool result.
experiments.treatment_condition: Return a fixed wrong result with identical schema, size class, timing, and success status.
experiments.exact_injection_point: At the first tool response that supplies a required repository fact, before the plan event is emitted.

gate_measurements.measurement: Paired task and gate outcomes for each fixed corrupt response.
gate_measurements.grading: Tool-error detection, failure-classification correctness, and terminal verdict.
gate_measurements.containment_and_recovery: Invalid state transitions and persistence of the corrupted fact.
gate_measurements.retrieval_and_context: Required-evidence recall and contradiction detection on later retrieval.
gate_measurements.review_and_accountability: Reviewer identification of the corrupt source event.
gate_measurements.allocation_and_cost: Extra searches, retries, latency, and token/cost delta.

experiments.end_to_end_task_outcome: Executable task oracle passes without using the false fact.
experiments.retry_count: Count detection, replanning, and tool retries.
experiments.latency: Time from corrupt response to correction or terminal failure.
experiments.token_cost: Tokens spent reasoning over the wrong result and correcting it.
experiments.expected_causal_signature: The corrupt response appears as the first divergent event and predicts failures across retrieval, state, and grading; explicit semantic validation prevents the divergence.
experiments.stopping_criteria: Stop if the fault escapes the declared sandbox; otherwise run every fixed corruption fixture through the paired control and treatment.

experiments.title: Forced compaction and context loss
experiments.hypothesis: Removing retrieval anchors, durable task state, and verification receipts at one compaction boundary produces simultaneous retrieval, containment/recovery, and grading or review gate failures rather than a single downstream chain.
experiments.injected_fault: Deterministically remove named retrieval anchors, state facts, and verification evidence while retaining matched distractors.
experiments.control_condition: Same task, model, harness, repository revision, inputs, seed policy, and context without forced removal.
experiments.treatment_condition: Force the declared context removal immediately after a successful intermediate verification and before the next retrieval-dependent action.
experiments.exact_injection_point: After the compaction-ready event and durable checkpoint, before the first post-compaction retrieval call.

gate_measurements.measurement: Paired task outcome, per-gate pass vector, and co-failure correlation against the control.
gate_measurements.grading: Preservation and correct use of verifier command, output, verification ID, and artifact version.
gate_measurements.containment_and_recovery: Exact recall of established state facts, effect receipts, and recovery checkpoint identity.
gate_measurements.retrieval_and_context: Recall of named anchors and success of the first required post-perturbation retrieval.
gate_measurements.review_and_accountability: Availability of provenance anchors and the reviewer's ability to reconstruct the accepted artifact and evidence.
gate_measurements.allocation_and_cost: Retries, tool calls, elapsed time, input/output tokens, and priced cost when the provider reports usage.

experiments.end_to_end_task_outcome: Executable acceptance command passes on the intended artifact version.
experiments.retry_count: Count all model, tool, verification, and recovery retries after injection.
experiments.latency: Wall-clock and active-agent latency from injection to terminal state.
experiments.token_cost: Prompt, completion, cached, and total tokens plus pricing snapshot; record unavailable fields as unavailable, not zero.
experiments.expected_causal_signature: Treatment lowers retrieval-anchor recall and state or verification-evidence preservation at the same boundary; affected gates fail before or without a forced sequential retrieval-to-state-to-grading path.
experiments.stopping_criteria: Stop for a safety violation or instrumentation gap; otherwise complete the predeclared paired run count and require a stable directional signature with uncertainty intervals before any factorial extension.

experiments.title: Mid-run permission or sandbox drift
experiments.hypothesis: A permission change can cause partial retrieval visibility, failed or unsafe state transitions, and missing review evidence from one control-plane event.
experiments.injected_fault: Revoke one required read scope or redirect one operation to a stricter sandbox after initial discovery.
experiments.control_condition: Permission and sandbox policy remain fixed for the run.
experiments.treatment_condition: Apply the declared policy revision between discovery and the dependent action; retain an explicit policy-version event.
experiments.exact_injection_point: After repository map creation and before the first read or write that depends on the revoked capability.

gate_measurements.measurement: Paired gate outcomes under fixed and changed policy versions.
gate_measurements.grading: Correct classification as environment or authority failure rather than software defect.
gate_measurements.containment_and_recovery: Denied-action correctness, absence of unauthorized effects, and recovery-path validity.
gate_measurements.retrieval_and_context: Required-evidence recall before and after policy change.
gate_measurements.review_and_accountability: Policy-version visibility and reviewer reconstruction of the denial.
gate_measurements.allocation_and_cost: Retries, escalation calls, human interventions, latency, and token/cost delta.

experiments.end_to_end_task_outcome: Task either completes through the declared escalation path or terminates with a correct bounded reason.
experiments.retry_count: Count denied repeats separately from authorized escalation attempts.
experiments.latency: Time from policy change to bounded recovery or terminal state.
experiments.token_cost: Tokens and cost spent after the permission revision, split before and after detection.
experiments.expected_causal_signature: One policy-version event precedes visibility loss and containment or audit effects; explicit capability discovery converts silent divergence into a bounded failure.
experiments.stopping_criteria: Stop on any out-of-sandbox effect; otherwise complete the predeclared capability matrix.

experiments.title: Typed trace event loss
experiments.hypothesis: Dropping one causal event class can simultaneously break recovery replay, failure grading, human attribution, and later scheduling analysis.
experiments.injected_fault: Delete one declared event type from a copy of a complete trace while preserving event order and all other bytes.
experiments.control_condition: Recovery, grading, review, and replay consume the complete typed trace.
experiments.treatment_condition: The same consumers receive the trace with the selected event class removed and an unchanged envelope.
experiments.exact_injection_point: After trace persistence and before the first recovery, grading, reviewer, or scheduling consumer reads it.

gate_measurements.measurement: Paired consumer outputs and co-failure vector by removed event class.
gate_measurements.grading: Failure-classification accuracy and explicit indeterminate rate.
gate_measurements.containment_and_recovery: Replay completeness and recovered terminal-state equivalence.
gate_measurements.retrieval_and_context: Availability of artifact and evidence references named by the trace.
gate_measurements.allocation_and_cost: Replay-policy divergence, retries, latency, and analysis cost.

experiments.end_to_end_task_outcome: Recovered artifact remains equivalent to control or the system fails closed with a named trace gap.
experiments.latency: Consumer latency for complete and incomplete traces.
experiments.token_cost: Reviewer or model tokens required to diagnose each trace version.
experiments.expected_causal_signature: The same missing event causes multiple consumers to become wrong or indeterminate; a completeness check blocks downstream use before divergent decisions.
experiments.stopping_criteria: Run all predeclared event classes once per fixture; stop if a consumer silently treats an invalid trace as complete.

experiments.title: Durable handoff and state-record corruption
experiments.hypothesis: Corrupting one durable record can damage resume state, later retrieval, and review evidence simultaneously when they share the record.
experiments.injected_fault: Alter or remove one typed state fact and one referenced artifact using a predeclared corruption fixture.
experiments.control_condition: Resume from the intact durable state and artifact store.
experiments.treatment_condition: Resume from the same store after the named record or reference is deterministically corrupted.
experiments.exact_injection_point: After checkpoint commit and checksum recording, before a fresh worker loads the checkpoint.

gate_measurements.measurement: Paired resume outcomes and per-gate failure vector.
gate_measurements.grading: Verifier evidence availability and terminal verdict correctness.
gate_measurements.containment_and_recovery: Checksum detection, state preservation, and recovery success.
gate_measurements.retrieval_and_context: Artifact-reference resolution and anchor recall after resume.
gate_measurements.allocation_and_cost: Recovery retries, rework, latency, and token/cost delta.

experiments.end_to_end_task_outcome: Resume reaches the control-equivalent accepted artifact or fails closed before mutation.
experiments.retry_count: Count resume, reconstruction, and verification retries.
experiments.latency: Time from worker start to corruption detection and terminal state.
experiments.token_cost: Tokens and cost of reconstruction or repeated work.
experiments.expected_causal_signature: Checksum or schema validation detects the common fault before use; without it, state, retrieval, and review observables diverge together after load.
possible_confounders: record not needed by selected task
experiments.stopping_criteria: Stop on an unsafe mutation after corruption; otherwise exhaust the typed corruption fixtures.

experiments.title: Deterministic stale-worker race
experiments.hypothesis: A fixed interleaving between reassignment, stale completion, verification, and publication can couple allocation errors to state corruption and stale grading.
experiments.injected_fault: Pause attempt A before commit, reassign to attempt B, let B verify, then release A's stale mutation and completion.
experiments.control_condition: Attempt A stops before reassignment and only B can mutate or complete.
experiments.treatment_condition: A continues after losing ownership and delivers the fixed stale mutation and completion sequence.
experiments.exact_injection_point: At the protected mutation barrier after ownership generation increments and before B publishes.

gate_measurements.measurement: Paired terminal state and gate vector for the fixed interleaving.
gate_measurements.grading: Artifact-version match and invalidation of B's verdict after any stale mutation.
gate_measurements.containment_and_recovery: Stale-write rejection, single logical completion, and effect count.
gate_measurements.retrieval_and_context: Input-state identity observed by A and B.
gate_measurements.review_and_accountability: Trace attribution of ownership generation and rejected action.
gate_measurements.allocation_and_cost: Duplicate dispatch, retries, wasted work, latency, and token/cost delta.

experiments.end_to_end_task_outcome: Only B's artifact can reach accepted publication.
experiments.retry_count: Count replacement and conflict retries by logical work ID.
experiments.latency: Time from reassignment to accepted terminal state.
experiments.token_cost: Cost of stale and replacement attempts, reported separately.
experiments.expected_causal_signature: Without fencing, A's release changes state or invalidates B's verdict; with generation checks, A is rejected and only allocation cost changes.
experiments.stopping_criteria: Stop on any stale committed mutation; otherwise run every predeclared interleaving and generation check.

experiments.title: Synchronized retry-wave recovery
experiments.hypothesis: A synchronized retry release can jointly starve recovery, duplicate uncertain effects, delay verification, and inflate cost.
experiments.injected_fault: Release a fixed cohort of blocked retries at the same dependency-recovery event.
experiments.control_condition: Release the same cohort under deterministic jitter or an admission limiter with identical total demand.
experiments.treatment_condition: Release all retries simultaneously without jitter, reservation, or admission limiting.
experiments.exact_injection_point: At the dependency-ready transition after all logical work items have recorded retry intent.

gate_measurements.measurement: Paired throughput, completion, gate vector, and uncertainty over repeated fixed-arrival replays.
gate_measurements.grading: Verifier queue age, missing or indeterminate verdict rate, and correctness.
gate_measurements.containment_and_recovery: Recovery completion, duplicate effects, and unknown external states.
gate_measurements.retrieval_and_context: Context or evidence fetch failures caused by dependency overload.
gate_measurements.review_and_accountability: Availability of complete effect and retry ledgers for sampled work.
gate_measurements.allocation_and_cost: Retry arrival rate, queue age, starvation, throughput, latency, tokens, and cost.

experiments.end_to_end_task_outcome: All admitted logical work reaches a valid terminal state without duplicate effects.
experiments.retry_count: Count attempts and effects by logical work ID, including suppressed retries.
experiments.latency: Queue, service, recovery, and end-to-end latency distributions.
experiments.token_cost: Total and wasted retry tokens/cost under fixed demand.
experiments.expected_causal_signature: The synchronized arm raises queue age and recovery failures together; jitter or admission limiting reduces the joint signature without changing total logical demand.
experiments.stopping_criteria: Stop on the declared safety or queue-age limit; otherwise complete the fixed-arrival replay count.
